programs.name: Computing Science BCompSc
programs.a_level_offer: GCE A Levels aggregate 8 (best three A2 subjects, A*=6, A=5, B=4, C=3, D=2, E=1). UTS 2027 international table; scale from the academic entry requirements page.
programs.ib_offer: IB column of the UTS entry table reads 27/32 under the header 'IB / Predicted IB'; the table does not say which number applies to which (guide only, August 2026).
programs.ap_offer: No AP-specific requirement is published. US route: US High School Diploma plus SAT 1 at a competitive standard (2027 table: SAT 1120, ACT 21) or an approved associate degree from a community/junior college.
programs.required_subjects: Assumed knowledge: HSC Mathematics Advanced and any two units of English (Mathematics Extension 1 and English Advanced recommended).
programs.toefl_note: TOEFL iBT (Home Edition accepted): old 0-120 scale 79 overall with 21 in writing; new 1-6 scale 4 overall with 4.5 in writing. PTE Academic 58 overall, 50 in writing.
programs.english_note: Course page: IELTS Academic overall 6.5, writing 6.0 (also IELTS online/OSR per the English requirements page); Cambridge C1A/C2P 176 overall, 169 writing; UTS College AE5 pass.
programs.notes: Autumn (February/March) 2027 intake; Spring (July) also offered. The 'Standard' program is open to international students; the IDeA cadetship version is domestic only. Entry scores (ATAR 75, GCE 8, IB 27/32, SAT 1120, ACT 21) are from the 2027 International Undergraduate Course Summary Table, row C10476 (https://www.uts.edu.au/for-students/international/guides-for-international-students/contentassets/utsi-listing-grid-international-undergraduate-course-summary-table.pdf, 'correct as of August 2026', a guide only). Fee: the course page's 2027 indicative first-year tuition fee A$57,240 (the table lists A$28,620 per session). CRICOS 118360G, City campus (Ultimo). Deadline: UTS page lists 30 November for Autumn start for applicants outside Australia (15 January for those in Australia), without a year; taken as 30 Nov 2026 for Autumn 2027 (https://www.uts.edu.au/for-students/admissions-entry/how-to-apply/international-applicants). US route: https://www.uts.edu.au/for-students/admissions-entry/how-to-apply/international-applicants/academic-entry-requirements

programs.notes: Autumn (February/March) 2027 intake; Spring (July) also offered. Entry scores (ATAR 80, GCE 9, IB 29/34, SAT 1160, ACT 22) are from the 2027 International Undergraduate Course Summary Table, row C10348 (https://www.uts.edu.au/for-students/international/guides-for-international-students/contentassets/utsi-listing-grid-international-undergraduate-course-summary-table.pdf, 'correct as of August 2026', a guide only). Fee: the course page's 2027 indicative first-year tuition fee A$51,015 (the table lists A$25,508 per session). CRICOS 086359B, City campus (Ultimo). Deadline: UTS page lists 30 November for Autumn start for applicants outside Australia (15 January for those in Australia), without a year; taken as 30 Nov 2026 for Autumn 2027 (https://www.uts.edu.au/for-students/admissions-entry/how-to-apply/international-applicants). English page: https://www.uts.edu.au/for-students/admissions-entry/eligibility/english-language-requirements. US route: https://www.uts.edu.au/for-students/admissions-entry/how-to-apply/international-applicants/academic-entry-requirements
